messages:
maria: FYI support escalated a latency complaint from AcmeCorp — p95/p99 spiked ~2.5x after yesterday's runtime build. They report slow API responses for long-chat workloads (~2048 tokens).

support-bot: New ticket #INC-4921 linked: https://support.redwood/INC-4921 — customer provided traces and a small repro that hits only during longer sequence lengths.

kevin: grabbing logs now. which runtime build/commit did we push yesterday?

maria: deploy-bot shows canary build rtb-2026.3 with compile flag change: USE_SDP=auto (previously USE_SDP=off).

carl: that flag toggles SDPA fused kernels vs FlashAttention. SDPA fallback can be slower for certain heads/dims.

sumit: interesting — the repro indicates heavy attention dims (heads=32, head_dim=128) and seq=2048. With our FlashAttn kernel we previously saw flat latency. If SDPA is auto it might pick SDPA for that configuration and get worse p99.

alice: can we reproduce in staging? I have an instance pinned to the new build. I can run the repro load.

kevin: do the repro steps from the ticket: run the same prompt sequence 1000x, parallel=8, tokens ~2048. Ticket includes curl snippet.

maria: repro snippet for convenience:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPRO_KEY" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"open-like-3b","input":"<long_chat>","max_tokens":2048}' &
  if (( i % 8 == 0 )); then wait; fi
done
```

alice: running now against canary. first 50 requests look fine, p50 ~110ms, p95 ~420ms. After ramp p95 -> 950ms and p99 -> 1.6s.

carl: can you dump kernel selection logs? We added KA logs to /var/log/rtb/kernels.log when compiled in debug mode.

alice: tail shows lines like:
```
[2026-02-12T11:03:12Z] model=open-like-3b seq=2048 heads=32 head_dim=128 selected=sdpa_fused kernel=sdpa_launch
[2026-02-12T11:03:12Z] model=open-like-3b seq=512 heads=32 head_dim=128 selected=flash_attn kernel=flash_launch
```

sumit: confirmed — for long sequences we pick sdpa_fused now. FlashAttn was faster historically for our shapes. The auto logic probably mis-ranked kernels because of a new perf table change in rtb-2026.3.

kevin: mitigation plan? We should give the customer a quick toggle and a longer fix.

maria: short-term: hotfix rtb-2026.4 that forces USE_SDP=off (i.e., prefer FlashAttn) for canary and customer tenant. Medium-term: revert the perf table change and add regression tests. Long-term: improve kernel selection to consider empirical p95 heuristics, not just throughput.

carl: I can cut the hotfix right now. Steps:
1) set env REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=flashattn on tenant routing rules
2) redeploy canary slot with BUILD=rtb-2026.4 (compiles with USE_SDP=off)
3) monitor p95/p99 and rollback if any other regressions

alice: after setting REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=flashattn in canary, p95 down to ~380ms, p99 ~720ms within 3 minutes. Looks good.

support-bot: Updated ticket INC-4921: applied kernel-pref override for AcmeCorp canary, customer notified of temporary mitigation.

kevin: need a reproducible unit test in our perf-ci: add a test with seq=2048 heads=32 head_dim=128 and assert p99 <= 900ms on baseline. If it regresses, fail build.

sumit: I'll add a perf-ci job and a nightly benchmark across kernel candidates (flashattn vs sdpa_fused vs reference) to catch these regressions. Also will pin the perf-table commit until we validate.

maria: owner assignments:
- carl: ship rtb-2026.4 hotfix and kernel-pref toggle (ETA 30m)
- sumit: perf-ci regression test + perf-table rollback PR (ETA today EOD)
- kevin: coordinate customer comms + ensure metrics dashboards show tenant override flag
- alice: keep running repro and post mem/GC stats (maybe memory pressure interacts)

alice: quick note — while toggling we saw marginally higher GPU memory use with flashattn due to workspace allocation. monitoring shows +200MB per GPU but within limits. Mentioning because Dedicated customers might need headroom.

maria: good call — include memory delta in the KB article we send.

kevin: customer replied: "thanks — latencies look back to normal. can you keep us posted on long-term fix?" I told them we'll follow up once perf-ci and rollback are in.

carl: hotfix deployed to canary and AcmeCorp tenant. Logs show selection changed to flash_launch for seq=2048.

deploy-bot: Deployed canary rtb-2026.4 -> canary-03 by carl at 2026-02-12T11:42:10Z :rocket:

maria: closing loop: make postmortem note and add an ops playbook entry: when p95 regresses after build, check kernel selection logs and try kernel-pref override as first mitigation. Also add an alert on sudden shift in kernel distribution (e.g., sdpa_fused fraction > 30% for seq>=1024).

support-bot: Ticket INC-4921 marked awaiting-customer-confirmation.

kevin: anyone object to backporting rtb-2026.4 compile flags to stable branch? We should be conservative but customer impact is real.

sumit: no objection — will open PR and request expedited review. We should include the perf-ci guard before merging to stable.

maria: thanks all. i'll draft the internal incident note and the KB for support to use when similar tickets come in. :white_check_mark:
